parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query information about all clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs.

parameters.name: ForceSwitch
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to skip the current error. Valid values:

**true**: Skips the error.

**false**: Does not skip the error.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region.

> For more information, see [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
